subject: Paid Parking Kiosk Program Implementation
overview: The Council approved a special permit for an adult day healthcare facility and discussed regional infrastructure grants related to the state's new casinos. The session was dominated by a contentious debate regarding the rollout of the city's new parking kiosk system, resulting in several requested operational changes.

items.title: Commendation for Tree Warden Agnes Tudin
items.summary: Approved a commendation for Tree Warden Agnes "Aggie" Tudin in recognition of her selection as the Seth H. Swift Tree Warden of the Year.

items.title: Special Permit: Medford Adult Day Healthcare Center
items.summary: Approved a special permit for an adult day healthcare center at 101 Mystic Avenue, with an additional request for a report from the Building Commissioner regarding the zoning classification of the facility.

items.title: Resolution: Dr. Lorenzo Lepore
items.summary: Congratulated Dr. Lorenzo Lepore for the passage of state legislation regarding the sterilization of musical wind instruments in schools.

items.title: Discussion: Parking Revenue Enhancement Program
items.summary: Discussed significant public and business opposition to the new parking kiosk program, amending the resolution to request a 10-minute grace period, color-coded tickets with return envelopes, and a legal review of the Council's prior votes. The Council also voted to request that the word "officer" be removed from citations issued by private Republic Parking employees.

items.title: Petition: Haines Square Redevelopment
items.summary: Referred a presentation by Jean Martin regarding the revitalization of Haines Square and the relocation of the MBTA bus barn to the Mayor for review.

items.title: Resolution: Auburn Street Truck Traffic
items.summary: Referred complaints about late-night and weekend truck traffic on Auburn Street to the Police Chief to coordinate delivery schedule changes with Whole Foods management.

items.title: Resolution: Gaming Act Community Mitigation Fund
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration apply for a $100,000 local reserve grant to mitigate casino-related traffic and infrastructure impacts in Wellington.

items.title: Approval of Records
items.summary: Approved the meeting records from December 16, 2014, and January 13, 2015.

items.title: MLK Day Event Report
items.summary: Received a report on the third annual Martin Luther King Jr. Day event and student presentations regarding intolerance held at the West Medford Community Center.
